affiliation: Independent model. Not affiliated with Meta or the LLaMA model family.

ask.behavior: Answers from the on-site knowledge base before the trained model publishes; upgrades to the live model automatically once published.

ask_url.description: Opens the site with the on-site guide answering the question.

engine.example: await SigLlama.load('https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-backend/sigllama/'); const t = await SigLlama.generate('Hello,', { maxTokens: 80, temperature: 0.8, topK: 40 });
engine.generate: await SigLlama.generate(prompt, { maxTokens, temperature, topK, stopAtEos, onToken }) -> Promise<string>

term_url.description: Opens the site on a dictionary word, e.g. ?term=transformer.

creator: Justin Addam Higgins
description: A tiny transformer language model I built and trained from scratch on the IWB Dictionary and Signature spec text. Runs entirely in the browser: no API keys, no servers, no fees — currently free for all internet tasks.

ask_api.description: Standalone ask API. Include via script tag, then call SignatureLlama.ask().

dictionary.description: 312 original one-sentence LLM/AI definitions. Schema: {"terms": [{"t": term, "d": definition, "c": category}]}.

explainer_kb.description: On-site guide knowledge base: Signature Llama, its files, libraries, tools. Schema: {"entries": [{"id", "title", "kind": "file|library|tool|concept", "kw": [keywords], "text"}]}.

patch_zip.description: Whole Llama patch: engine, weights (or placeholder), vocab, all source tools, dictionary JSON, explainer knowledge base, embed snippet, patch notes.

weights.description: Int8 quantized weights. Published when training completes; absent until then.

tool_libraries.description: 120+ plug-in tool libraries of real runnable JS for LLM/AI functions (text, reasoning, memory, chat, search, math, web, data, voice, safety, embed, fun), each registering under SigLlama.tools.<id>, with an optimal all-purpose setting. Schema: {"updated", "optimal": {"sampling", "note"}, "libraries": [{"id", "name", "category", "desc", "version", "optimal", "functions", "code"}]}.

license: Free for any website, app, or project. No API key, no fee, credit appreciated. Independent model by Justin Addam Higgins, not affiliated with Meta.

model.tokenizer: character-level, trained on creator's own text
model.training_data: IWB Dictionary definitions + Signature spec text (creator-authored)
